Global Properties presents this large 6 bedroom, 4 bathroom detached home, situated in the mature Ard Na Greine estate, Macroom. This property is in excellent condition throughout and offers stunning views overlooking macroom town. This impressive detached family home offers generous and versatile accommodation, stunning views over Macroom town, and a convenient location within easy reach of schools, shops, and local amenities.

Macroom, Co. Cork is a vibrant market town set along the banks of the River Lee, approximately 35 minutes west of Cork and 35 minutes east of Killarney. Rich in history and character, the town is home to the impressive Macroom Castle and offers a lively mix of shops, cafés, schools, and local amenities. Surrounded by beautiful countryside and acting as a gateway to West Cork, Macroom provides residents with a perfect balance of small-town charm, strong community spirit, and convenient access to the city.
